content.comment_body: I have a 4–20 mA pressure sensor with a range from 0 to 0.6 bar, connected to analogue input module [product_name]. In the function block diagram, the analog input is linked to an analog threshold with default settings (0–1000), and I've configured one decimal place for messages. Everything works as expected: 4 mA (0 bar) shows as 0%, 20 mA (0.6 bar) as 100%. I’d like to adjust this so that the message displays 100% when the sensor reads 0.35 bar instead of 0.6 bar. How can I achieve this?
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Attached is one possible solution.
Thanks for your help, much appreciated. That worked perfectly. It always seems easy once you know how! Thanks again.

analysis.insight_summary: The user needed to adjust the scaling of a 4–20 mA pressure sensor connected to an analogue module, so that 100% was indicated at 0.35 bar rather than the default 0.6 bar. The thread shows that this customization can be accomplished by modifying software settings, successfully meeting the user's process control requirement and demonstrating the flexibility of the available scaling options.
